title: Optimistic Nihilism
summary: Kurzgesagt's short animated take on optimistic nihilism. It argues the universe has no inherent meaning, so we are free to create our own and enjoy life.
why: HN users recommend it as a comforting, clear introduction to nihilism for anxiety, mid-life doubts and feeling behind in life.

quote.text: I highly recommend it, as they explain these concepts very well in a short 6min video.
